summary: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging.
takeaways: Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging.
We present PCBRouteAgent, a multimodal PCB routing agent inspired by how human engineers coordinate global strategy with local execution.
We evaluate PCBRouteAgent on 247 synthetic and real-world boards from four PCBWorld-Bench test splits.
